components.name: OpenClaw memory core and bundled source dependencies
components.notes: Pinned upstream algorithm bodies are bundled from byte-identical source inputs. An export-only build transform exposes the private Dreaming runner. Shoggoth host adapters provide Profile, file, session, SQLite, model and embedding ownership; the network module loader resolves bundled Undici instead of optional desktop dependencies. fs-safe 0.24.0, p-limit 7.3.3, p-map 7.0.8, yocto-queue 1.2.2, kysely 0.29.6, ipaddr.js 2.5.0, undici 8.11.2, ansi-regex 6.4.0, get-east-asian-width 1.7.0, string-width 8.2.2, strip-ansi 7.2.0 and typebox 1.3.34 retain their original MIT notices. OpenAI/Mistral/Voyage/Google/Ollama provider source is included but has no Product credential or production selection binding. No external OpenClaw installation or Gateway is used.

components.name: Memory MIME detection and AI option dependencies
components.revision: file-type 22.1.1; dependency versions and per-file SHA-256 in build/shoggoth-memory/manifest.json
components.notes: Original dependencies are bundled from byte-identical package source inputs. Versions and package tarball integrity match the pinned OpenClaw lockfile. file-type 22.1.1, @tokenizer/inflate 0.4.1, strtok3 10.3.5, token-types 6.1.2, uint8array-extras 1.5.0, debug 4.4.3, @borewit/text-codec 0.2.2, ms 2.1.3 and partial-json 0.1.7 retain MIT notices; ieee754 1.2.1 retains BSD-3-Clause. partial-json is in the original AI options module's parsing closure. This component does not enable remote media upload, legacy Claude thinking or production multimodal configuration.

components.name: gogcli Gmail MCP runtime

components.notes: Unmodified upstream gogcli executable; Shoggoth adds a separate Service-owned account, tool, and permission adapter. The MIT notice text is retained with the distributed binary.

components.name: OpenClaw Control UI
components.revision: v2026.8.1 (workboard source annotation); other ports retain their source-file mappings
components.notes: Adapted to React/TypeScript, localized, and integrated with Shoggoth. The upstream Pi/pi-mono notice is retained conservatively.

components.name: Hermes Agent model settings
components.notes: Shoggoth source annotations describe porting the upstream model/provider settings workflow. Adapted UI/API integration; original import revision and copied-line extent were not recorded. Upstream notice is retained conservatively rather than asserting every local line was copied.

components.name: LiquidGlass
components.notes: Upstream README/package.json explicitly declare MIT. Four shader bodies match this reference after removing comments/whitespace; the glass fragment shader and renderer are adapted. Original import commit was not recorded; this is a verified source reference, not a claim about the original import date.

components.name: Lobe Icons provider logos

components.name: Lucide / Feather icons
